candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in inventory, causing POST /v1/reservations to return 503, which propagates through order to gateway checkout as 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (server metrics, connection state) is not in scope; timeout cause (saturation vs. network) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts with DependencyUnavailable, 503 on /v1/reservations, and 502s on /v1/orders and /v1/checkout across all correlated requests; gateway logs and metrics confirm ~2s checkout latency and 502s. Topology links inventory to redis. Bounded to redis-timeout.
